item.title: I rubbish spread all over pavement and road., 30th September
item.description:
On 29 September 2026 at approximately 5:30pm, I witnessed a man, whom I know as Mr Jon Cox emptying the contents of his plastic wheelie bin onto the pavement and road leaving the rubbish there. Which is in the way of cars turning. The incident occurred on the entrance road to Pengarth Road, Bexley. I also know the address associated with this person and can provide it to the council if required. I am happy to provide any further information or evidence I have regarding the incident.

Nearest road to the pin placed on the map (automatically generated by OpenStreetMap): Pengarth Road, Blendon, Greater London
Report on FixMyStreet
